description: Source: WHO Mortality Database, February 2026 release (raw files downloaded from cdn.who.int on 10 October 2026, Eu40_APC NOTES item 2); person-years WHO, else UN WPP calibrated to WHO by sex and age (NOTES item 84); UN WPP: UN World Population Prospects (revision to be confirmed), estican data/UNDP/pop_UN.rds of 2 June 2026 (as used for GLOBOCAN 2024; read-only); via output/data_build/, output/sdg34/, Study/output/replication/, data/dict/, data/derived/, LICENSE and the scripts it links to and shows; docs/who_mortality_harmonisation.Rmd with code/08_data.Rmd, code/08_who_processing.Rmd and code/08_helpers.R. Written by code/16_docs.R

Web page (GitHub Pages: branch main, folder docs/; the empty docs/.nojekyll serves the folder as is): how the WHO Mortality Database was harmonised and cleaned, Section 1 of report/premature_global.html (Tables 1.1-1.8, Figure D1) from the same children, with links to the files of the public repository on GitHub (main branch; only the files listed in docs/published.csv) and the code lines of the data build inside the page; appendix: R code of the data build (code/functions_pm.R, 01-04; folded, numbered, not run) and the columns of data/dict/who_cause_groups.csv and data/dict/areas.csv (a CSV is embedded for download only if published)
